hero.title: Write once, build every language
hero.subtitle: This tiny page is translated at build time into English, Spanish and Arabic. No runtime, no framework, no client-side flash of untranslated content.

static.title: Fully static output
static.text: Every language is a plain directory of HTML files. Host it anywhere.

seo.title: SEO baked in
seo.text: Each page carries hreflang alternates pointing at its sibling locales.

rtl.title: RTL aware
rtl.text: Arabic, Hebrew and other RTL locales flip the document direction automatically.

footer.line: Built with moonlingo, the zero-dependency i18n build tool.
